note: Slots are x/y/w/h in the asset’s own canvas coordinates, origin top-left; multiply by delivered/canvas to reach pixels. No text, number or datum is drawn in any asset. BOIL: every plate that was previously one static PNG is delivered as 3 genuinely redrawn frames at 7fps (playback "boil") — the drawing is made again with a moved seed, so each frame’s line lands 2-3% differently; nothing is transformed and no slot moves between frames. Slot names and x/y/w/h are identical across all four registers and across every frame and clutter state — only the mark-making differs, so a register or a state can be swapped with no recalculation. WORLD PALETTE (post-it #e8d98a, mug #c98b52, can #7b9aa8, curtain #d8cfc0, plant #a8845c) appears only on physical objects in the room, never on a chart, table, card, number, label or plate interior. The plant is brown because it is dying, which keeps green meaning an up move and nothing else. GROUP F containers draw no data: frame, axis furniture, rules and header only, with empty interiors for code. GROUP AMB are the five ambient loops that run continuously under everything (steam, plant, curtain, cursor, second hand); loop-plant and loop-curtain REPLACE the plate’s drawn plant and curtain rather than overlaying them. The evidence wall declares the same nine pin slots in all three states. sheet-wide returns eight row bands; comps-table returns row AND column bands. Group M (light) is register-agnostic and delivered once: composite above the plate and below anything code draws, so ink stays ink. Group ID (avatars, banners) exists once, in marker: the channel has one identity.

groups.G: the host: poses, idles, faces, gestures

files.numbering: single-frame assets have no suffix; multi-frame assets are _f01.._fNN in playback order
files.note: light is group M — register-agnostic, delivered once, not per register
